content: Hi, how can i assist you today?
Books keep opening to pages with lines that match my thoughts. It’s like guidance.
I can’t verify guidance. When you say ‘keep opening,’ do you mean after placing the book down, or on first open each time?
Mostly first open. The line fits what I was thinking.
A blind draw test could help: choose a page number with dice, then open and see whether the line still fits as often.
Record total draws vs. matches across multiple titles. If the match rate is similar across random and self-selected opens, broad applicability might be at play.
Maybe I notice the lines that fit.
That’s common. Keeping both ‘fits’ and ‘doesn’t fit’ examples in the log shows the full distribution.
